scripts.build:schema: if-file-exists src/settings.ts "typescript-json-schema src/settings.ts PluginSettings --required --out dist/schema.json" "shx cp src/schema.json dist/ 2>/dev/null || true"
scripts.build:types: if-file-exists src/index.ts "tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationDir dist" "shx cp src/index.d.ts dist/ 2>/dev/null || true"
scripts.build: npm run clean && shx mkdir -p dist && npm run build:js && npm run build:schema && npm run build:types && npm run finalize && npm run zip
